card.title: The Rule You Broke
card.instruction: Treat a past breach of rule or custom as unfinished business. Let every present exception reopen the question of what was damaged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're swapping your birthday-tea duty again? Last time you left me serving forty people alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time Maya agreed to cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put her name on the rota. Mine appeared after you'd gone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll write that you weren't responsible last time, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the complaint about the cold tea, please. That's where everyone learned I was unreliable.

mechanism: A treats a new rota exception as reopening the earlier unassigned duty and the reputation damage left by its complaint.
confusable: Unlike generalized fear of lost authority, A seeks acknowledgment of the particular old breach and its remaining consequences.
comparison: The tea-duty alternative places a correction beside the public complaint; the mugs alternative asks repair history be included in a habitual warning.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
